title: Signal Board
summary: A fictional example of a calmer way to see moving parts at a glance.
description: Signal Board is an illustrative dashboard concept that turns a collection of updates into a clearer overview.
The silent preview shows a fictional dashboard with colored status rows and gently moving bars. It is generated artwork, not a recording of a real client or production system.
